highlights: Earn up to 10% cashback on McDonald's, Starbucks, Netflix, Spotify, and more, capped at S$15 per month. You can also earn an additional 5% Green Cashback at selected eco-friendly merchants, also capped at S$15 per month. For all other transactions, earn 0.30% cashback, capped at S$20 per month. Monthly cashback cap of S$50
pros: Enjoy 5% Cashback on McDonald's, Starbucks, Golden Village, Netflix and Spotify.
pros: Enjoy additional 5% Green Cashback on selected eco-friendly Eateries, Retailers, and Transport Services.
pros: 0.3% Cashback on All Other Spend

extra.description: Tailor-made for the student lifestyle, the DBS Live Fresh Student Card offers a refreshing approach to managing your expenses. Enjoy cashback rewards on your everyday spending, exclusive discounts, and seamless mobile banking.
